meta.title: Refresh Argo Phase 0 PR with parser-level revocation coverage
meta.author: manager

feature.problem_statement: Infra PR #1155 contains the intended Argo deny-by-default and legacy MetaMCP revocation controls, but it is 14 commits behind canonical main and its fake-kubectl tests do not prove the exact Go templates parse in real kubectl.
goals: Refresh the existing PR branch onto exact canonical main without reverting unrelated platform work.
Add real-kubectl parser coverage for the exact account and token state templates.
Produce a fresh exact-head reviewed and CI-validated PR while preserving all lockout safety controls.
non_goals: Dispatch the revocation or break-glass workflows.
Create GitHub environments, secrets, runners, Authentik identities, or live authorization state.
Deploy Argo default deny or activate Access Controller writes.
scope_in: Rebase security/argo-default-deny from b6bed30712e85bf9885211ceb35e739ac72e273f onto 4096b5da32b4e734e05552a8ede7dc58dd01deaf, the canonical main observed after the first guarded rebase stopped on concurrent movement.
Resolve overlapping files narrowly, preserving current-main behavior and the reviewed Phase 0 delta.
Add offline parser-level regression tests using real kubectl for present and absent account/token keys.
Run focused repository validation, independent Luna review, and fresh exact-head PR checks.
scope_out: Live cluster reads beyond already captured evidence.
Any workflow dispatch, merge, deployment, credential access, or authorization mutation.
Weakening or bypassing missing environment, reviewer, runner, Authentik, or break-glass gates.

requirements.statement: The refreshed branch MUST descend from exact canonical main 4096b5da32b4e734e05552a8ede7dc58dd01deaf and MUST preserve unrelated current-main changes.
requirements.rationale: The existing security branch is stale and overlaps platform topology checks.

requirements.statement: Tests MUST execute the exact account_state and token_state Go templates through a real kubectl client-side template parser for present and absent keys.
requirements.rationale: The fake kubectl transaction harness cannot detect invalid Go-template syntax.

requirements.statement: The refresh MUST preserve token-first revocation, resourceVersion and old-value guards, role:readonly precondition, three explicit human admin mappings, explicit kubeconfig/context/API authority, pinned kubectl verification, and idempotent partial-failure behavior.
requirements.rationale: These controls form the reviewed lockout-safe and fail-closed transaction boundary.

requirements.statement: The branch update MUST use an exact expected lease for b6bed30712e85bf9885211ceb35e739ac72e273f and MUST stop if the remote branch or canonical main changes unexpectedly.
requirements.rationale: Concurrent platform work is active and stale force-pushes are forbidden.

requirements.statement: The work MUST stop before merge, workflow dispatch, deployment, credential access, environment creation, or live authorization mutation and MUST report all external safety gates as unresolved.
requirements.rationale: Required environment protection, trusted runner, Authentik session proof, and local-admin break-glass proof are not established.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Given canonical main 4096b5da and old PR head b6bed307, when the branch is refreshed, then main is an ancestor, range-diff is reviewed, the Phase 0 delta remains scoped, and current-main topology/publication controls are retained.
Given fixtures with account/token keys present or absent, when the exact templates are evaluated by real kubectl offline, then parsing succeeds and returns the expected apiKey/present/absent states.

Given existing transaction and RBAC tests, when focused validation runs after refresh, then token-first guarded revocation, idempotency, partial failure, admin continuity, and permissionless default policy contracts all pass unchanged.
Given expected remote head b6bed307, when the refreshed branch is pushed, then force-with-lease succeeds only if that exact remote head is unchanged and the resulting PR head is recorded.

Given the refreshed PR, when code review and CI complete, then no merge, dispatch, deployment, environment/secret/runner change, or live authorization mutation has occurred and all external gates remain explicit NO-GO conditions.

test_plan.approach: Use ancestry, name-status, range-diff, focused topology checks, transaction tests, RBAC contract tests, break-glass guards, shell/Python syntax, actionlint, and diff checks.
Run exact extracted templates through real kubectl using offline client dry-run or a loopback fake API server and assert account/token present and absent outputs.
Push with exact force-with-lease, independently review the exact new SHA, and inspect all PR checks without merging or dispatching workflows.

review_checks: Review range-diff and every overlapping conflict resolution.
validation_checks: Verify canonical main is an ancestor and unrelated main changes remain.

review_checks: Confirm tests execute exact production templates, not copied approximations.
validation_checks: Present and absent account/token fixtures pass real kubectl parsing.

review_checks: Review revocation sequencing, guards, admin mappings, and default policy.
validation_checks: Existing adversarial transaction and RBAC suites remain green.

review_checks: Re-read canonical main and remote PR head immediately before push.
validation_checks: Remote update uses exact expected lease and recorded resulting head.

review_checks: Confirm environment, runner, Authentik, and break-glass blockers remain explicit.
validation_checks: Audit GitHub/live state for absence of merge, dispatch, deployment, or authorization mutation.

perspectives.summary: Refresh narrowly onto exact main, preserve overlapping topology/publication changes, add exact parser coverage, and push only with an exact lease.
Treat environment protection, secret scope, runner isolation, Authentik continuity, and break-glass proof as hard merge/deploy gates outside this code refresh.
Use real kubectl parsing plus existing fake-cluster transaction suites, focused static checks, independent exact-head review, and fresh PR CI.

council.consensus_summary: Proceed only with rebase and parser-test hardening. The current indexed templates are valid; do not claim or re-fix a stale defect. Stop after exact-head PR evidence and keep merge/deploy NO-GO.
open_questions: Which independently trusted reviewer and dedicated runner will later protect codicarium-management-break-glass?
When will a browser or Authentik connector be attached for admin and ordinary-user proof?
